description: This is a simple Android Activity class implementing a minimal 'Hello, World!' application. It extends the Activity class, overrides the onCreate method to set up the activity's UI by inflating a layout resource, and sets the content view.

classes.name: HelloActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that displays a simple layout upon creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created. Sets up the layout by inflating a resource and assigning it as the content view.
